required_fields: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with cohort-specific frequencies (numerator and denominator per cohort, not percentage alone), including verbatim paper wording and standard HPO terms where identifiable
PMID or DOI citation and cohort identification attached to every reported phenotype frequency

Most discriminating findings (present in most affected individuals but uncommon in disorders with overlapping phenotypes), including the names of confused disorders and the confidence of the distinction
Phenotypes looked for and found absent in affected individuals (findings whose presence argues against the diagnosis)
Phenotype differences correlated with variant type, position, age, or sex
Findings reported by one paper that are explicitly contradicted by another
